sections_refined: From nebula to a stable star

coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed all four PMT summary pages, four SR Space pages and 4.8. Existing orbital, stellar life-cycle and spectral diagrams retained. Added energy during protostar collapse, fuel-use rate, matching-line comparison and distinct expansion evidence. A brief CMB paragraph provides supporting explanation, without advanced cosmology calculations. Rejected PMT planetary nebula as a small supernova, CMB from early stars/rocks, SR gravitational potential energy rising during collapse and expanded radius alone determining stellar route. Excluded H-R diagram and orbit derivations not required by 4.8.
